name: FXWIZARD
author: amnmkkr
description: Bastl Instruments' Kastle 2 FX Wizard (MIT) as a send effect: nine effects (delay, flanger, freezer, panner, crusher, slicer, pitcher, replayer, shifter) on MODE, TIME, FEEDBACK and AMOUNT. FX Wizard's own code runs unchanged at 44 kHz; its clock follows the Rytm's tempo and its trigger fires every bar.
